name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-09-09.134.1) "*That so much of the standing orders be suspended as would prevent the motion for the third reading being moved without delay.*" In other words, they voted to end debate and instead vote on whether to pass the bill right away. Standing orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament. ### What does this bill do?
